summary: Argonaut's Croc series began as a 1997 3D platformer and now has a modern remaster route alongside original PlayStation, Saturn, and PC versions.

entries.title: Croc: Legend of the Gobbos
entries.definitive_edition: 2025 remaster for current access; original PS1/Saturn/PC for strict historical comparison

emulation.emulator: PS1/Saturn emulation only for original comparison
emulation.notes: Native remaster route is preferred for current access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current remaster or original hardware/emulation with route labeled

primary.version: 2025 remaster, with original PS1/Saturn/PC route documented separately
primary.why: The 2025 remaster is the current official route and adds modern controls, enhanced visuals, and gallery material. Original PlayStation, Saturn, and Windows releases remain important because camera/control feel and presentation differ.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current remaster on GOG or console for the main route. Record version, classic versus modern controls, visual/filter settings, level, collectable state, gallery/time-trial content, and whether original PS1/Saturn/PC behavior was compared.

secondary.why: The remaster changes presentation and controls.

all_releases.platform: Croc: Legend of the Gobbos remaster
all_releases.fidelity: Current official remaster with modern controls, enhanced visuals, and bonus material.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is current and accessible, while original camera/control behavior is a separate preservation route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record classic/modern control mode and remaster patch state.
